verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that 1Password stores one-time passwords alongside logins, and that items are organized into vaults within a Business account (CLI vault scoping, Connect access to vaults). Nothing in the pack documents sharing those vaults with a team or setting per-member permissions, which is the core of the story. Missing for 10: documented shared vaults or collections for teams, per-member or group access-control settings, admin workflow for sharing TOTP-enabled logins, and independent corroboration.
